baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: The base URL of the OpenG2P Registry partner API

senderId.title: Sender ID
senderId.description: Partner sender ID, used as header.sender_id. The registry resolves it to PARTNER_<SENDER_ID> in Partner Management

privateKey.title: Private Key
privateKey.description: PEM-encoded RSA, EC P-256 or Ed25519 private key used to sign requests

keyId.title: Key ID
keyId.description: Optional key ID, sent as the JWS kid header

algorithm.title: Signing Algorithm
algorithm.description: Optional override for the JWS algorithm. Derived from the key type by default
